this is a quality-of-life feature that is very useful for intermediate computer users,
that i expected to already be in Godot because [this text in Godot docs](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/tutorials/scripting/filesystem.html#project-godot) implies it's there:

> Even an empty ``project.godot`` can function as a basic definition of a blank project.

title: Show the project creation dialog when opening an empty `project.godot` file
